description: reports.py filters records by a minimum score. Two defects are reported: the comparison uses > so records exactly at the threshold are dropped, and records without a usable numeric score raise KeyError or TypeError instead of being skipped. Fix filter_by_score() so the threshold is inclusive and records with a missing or non-numeric score are excluded without raising.
expected_behavior: filter_by_score([{'score': 5}], 5) keeps the record. Records with no 'score' key, None, or a string are skipped. Order is preserved.
notes: Synthetic defect seeded for the VerifyLoop benchmark. Not a production incident.
title: Score filter excludes the boundary and crashes on missing data
